header: This is the PDF of an announcement, full screen over the home page, not in a new tab: the layer of the circular viewer (src/components/ViewerShell.tsx, shared with src/components/CircularViewerLightbox.tsx) with its cross and the announcement's title, and the PDF filling the room below. It closes with the cross and with Escape (as the circular viewer does) and leaves the announcement's window exactly as it was.
* I draw it in a portal on <body>: the announcement's window has its own stacking and is itself closed by a click on its backdrop, and a click here must not reach it.

* Escape closes THIS viewer only: I take the key in the capture phase (the same way ImageLightbox does it) and the layer carries data-escape-own, so neither TopBar's handler nor the search window's (when the announcement was opened from a search result) closes what is behind it.
* The page's scrolling is locked while it is open (the shared lock, src/lib/ui/scrollLock.ts).
* The PDF is the one our own route serves (src/app/api/announcements/[id]/file/route.ts).

symbols.name: FULL_SCREEN_VIEW
doc: This is how I open the PDF in the full-screen viewer: thumbnail panel closed, and a fixed 150% zoom. Not "fit to width": that stretched a page to the whole width of a wide screen. 150% is the same size on every screen (the reader can still zoom from the browser's own PDF toolbar).

symbols.name: fullScreenView
doc: I keep the layer itself apart from the portal and the effects, so that it can be drawn and tested on the server. The same, but opened on a page: the page the search found the words on.
